description: A review sheet of the open scene, the way to judge a piece before calling it done: frames across it (default eight; or `times`) as one picture, and the flags — layers past the frame (more than 0.05 of the frame), text under 14 px on the frame, text under 3:1 contrast against what is behind it, motion hitches (a speed that jumps or a path that turns a corner mid-move). Fix what is flagged unless it is a deliberate choice you can name.
name: review_sheet
